source_format: deterministic JSON geometry + animation in art/models/ (export space)

coordinate_system.model_export_space: block-corner origin, X=width [0,Size.X], Y=height/up [0,Size.Y], Z=depth [0,Size.Z], front (outlet/pickup) at Z=0, intake at Z=Size.Z
coordinate_system.plugin_map: export = (-blender.x, blender.z, -blender.y); scene builder authors blender = (-export.x, -export.z, export.y) and the exporter reverses winding once so normals/winding stay outward

animation_contract.game_driver: blueprint MechanicalNodeAnimatorSpec -> MechanicalNodeAnimator (speed = PowerEfficiency * NonlinearAnimationManager.SpeedMultiplier; disabled at 0 power) - no C#/blueprint change needed
animation_contract.loop: first frame == last frame (integer turns / cycles); quaternion track made sign-continuous in post-process

uv_policy.source: art/material_texture_map.json + art/material_uv_policy.py (copied unchanged from HDBF ART-07)
uv_policy.policy: world-scale planar projection per dominant face normal at the material's ART-07 native texel density, capped by the material's actual projected span and kept inside its verified canvas (2 px guard); window centred on the material's own projected bbox; no UV rect is invented
